name: The Thandol Span
summary: On the Thandol Span, a murder exposes a threat to Ironforge's northern road. Ebenezer Rustlocke has been killed, and Rhag Garmason finds that Kam Deepfury has hidden explosives to cut that route.

sections.title: A Plot Revealed
sections.body: A recovered document reveals what happened beneath the Thandol Span. Ebenezer Rustlocke was murdered in its substructure, and the papers expose a further act of sabotage. Kam Deepfury, the Dark Iron agitator who first destroyed part of the bridge, has not stopped. His network planted a second cache of heavy munitions just across the northern border in the Arathi Highlands, ready to finish the destruction.

sections.title: Saving the Lifeline
sections.body: The Span links the southern kingdoms of Khaz Modan and Stormwind to the north's war-torn lands. Rhag Garmason orders an immediate strike against the sabotage cache in Arathi, before Deepfury's conspirators can use it. Destroying the munitions ends the immediate danger and preserves Ironforge's access to the north. Garmason still has too few troops to defend the gap.

faq.answer: Kam Deepfury is the Dark Iron dwarf mastermind behind the sabotage of the Thandol Span. After collapsing the first arch, he cached more explosives across the chasm in the Arathi Highlands to destroy the remaining bridge.

faq.q: Why is the Thandol Span so strategically vital?
faq.answer: The Span is the only land bridge across the immense chasm between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands. If it falls, the Alliance loses its main overland supply route between Ironforge, Stormwind, and its allies holding ground in northern Lordaeron.
Ebenezer Rustlocke was an Ironforge defender murdered beneath the bridge. His investigation and recovered papers led Rhag Garmason to uncover Deepfury's hidden explosive cache.

faq.q: Where is the cache of explosives hidden?
faq.answer: The explosives were hidden in a cache just across the Span, on the Arathi Highlands side. Deepfury's conspirators could quickly carry them to the surviving span structure.

faq.q: Who gives the order to destroy the explosives?
faq.answer: Rhag Garmason, a dwarf officer stationed on the Wetlands side of the Thandol Span, orders the cache found and demolished to honor Rustlocke's sacrifice and protect the remaining bridge.

faq.q: What happens after the munitions are destroyed?
faq.answer: After the munitions are destroyed, the immediate sabotage threat is over, but Rhag Garmason knows his garrison cannot hold the damaged bridge indefinitely without help. While waiting for Ironforge's reserves, he sends a plea for reinforcements to Captain Nials at the Alliance camp in Refuge Pointe, in the Arathi Highlands.

angles.text: For the sons of Ironforge, defending the Thandol Span protects King Magni's lifeline to northern allies and strikes a blow against traitorous Dark Iron infiltrators.
Holding the Span is essential for the safety of the continent. If the crossing falls, moving Alliance armies and resources into Arathi and Lordaeron becomes exponentially more dangerous.
As an engineer, you can appreciate the destructive power of Deepfury's munitions cache, built to demolish colossal titan-style dwarven stonework.
